description: Start here for a vague user request such as "T490 battery", "surface pro 11 screen" or a part number with or without dashes. Returns status resolved (a model plus part type and up to 10 candidates, or a part), needs_clarification (ONE clarifying_question: ask the user instead of guessing; raised for 5G vs Wi-Fi, Intel vs AMD, generation or touch screens) or not_found, plus a next tool call to make. Use search_parts instead for open-ended keyword browsing, and get_model_parts once you know the exact model slug.

type.description: Optional part type, e.g. Battery, Screen, Keyboard, Power Adapter, SSD, Memory (as in get_coverage part_types). Overrides any type word in query and limits candidates to that type; omit it and a type word in query is used, else the result asks which part.

name: resolve_request

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

title: Resolve a vague part request
